name: Domino's
verdict: Brand of Domino's Pizza, Inc. (NASDAQ: DPZ), a US listed franchisor: about 99% of its global stores are run by independent franchisees. Nothing found.
note: Rated during the Casa Pia research (issue #390): shorts sponsor of Casa Pia's 2026-27 home kit. The Portuguese operation is a master franchisee of Domino's Pizza, Inc.; the franchisee company is not named in the 10-K and was not identified, so the chain stops at the listed franchisor.
